title: Start teaching in a workspace
description: When I first open Workspace, I want to find or establish my teaching context so I can begin work with the right classroom.

intents.title: Start teaching in a workspace
intents.outcome: Enter an authorized teaching workspace or establish an independent classroom.

journeys.title: Start teaching in a workspace
journeys.situation: A teacher opens Workspace for the first time and needs to find an authorized school context or establish a supported independent teaching context.
journeys.outcome: Enter an authorized teaching workspace or establish an independent classroom.

existingBehavior: Web workspace shows a personal-scope state before institutional attendance.
Server provisioning can create a teacher-owned classroom and bond using an idempotent receipt.
invariants: The selected account and server-verified bond govern authority; a local draft never grants access.
A personal teaching context is distinct from an institutional school role.
A teacher may optionally contact the founder for a school; opening WhatsApp is not message delivery or an authorization grant.
Existing teaching, onboarding, school and personal flows are preserved.
openQuestions: How should a teacher provisioning command persist and reconcile across offline interruptions and account switches on web?
How should the bootstrap provisioning boundary align with Cedar and existing teacher bond checks?
Which existing school invitation and claim flows support teacher onboarding end to end?
Can signed Cedar snapshots, account-scoped draft persistence and outbox reconciliation support this journey on both platforms?

steps.title: Resolve teaching context
steps.interaction: Check the authenticated account and available scopes.

steps.title: Choose a teaching context
steps.interaction: Select an existing permitted context or begin a supported setup.

transitions.action: A new teaching bond is confirmed and selected
